faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

items.a: Yes. There is no paid plan, no credit card requirement, and no hidden limits on the core recap features.
MP4, MOV, WebM and MKV files are supported. For best results use MP4 with H.264 video.
Most videos finish in a few minutes. Longer videos take proportionally longer — you can leave the page and we'll keep working in the background.
Summaries and subtitles are available in Burmese (မြန်မာ) and English. Speech recognition works best with clear audio.
A free account is required to upload videos and keep your library. Signing up takes less than a minute with email or Google.
Your videos are processed securely and stored in your private library. You can delete any video at any time, which removes it permanently.
